feedback: After creating our workspace, admins cannot locate the invite teammates step. Support has to finish initial setup.
During first-time configuration, the timezone selector is hidden until after the workspace is saved.
New managers cannot complete the invite teammates wizard; it loops back to workspace creation.
Our setup checklist never explains which connector to enable first during launch. Once connected, data syncs correctly.
Every time a case is reassigned, agents get three emails and two push alerts about the same change.
Could we get a digest instead of immediate emails for low-priority comments throughout the shift?
The daily reminder is being sent hourly and our team cannot turn it off.
The sync works fine now, but repetitive sync completed notifications overwhelm agents.
Tickets appear in the dashboard, but the CSV export hides resolved cases even when the filter includes them.
The metrics are correct; supervisors just cannot find the breakdown by queue in the reporting interface.
The date filter resets whenever the report is reopened, so the team compares different time windows.
All records sync correctly, but the response-time chart does not explain whether it uses local time or UTC.
Our monthly invoice lists seat overages without naming which agents triggered those charges.
The renewal quote differs from our annual plan total and we cannot get an itemized explanation.
Seats were removed last month but charges continued; is the invoice prorated?
What does platform adjustment mean on our invoice, and why was the price changed?
After the CRM connector reconnects, old case history is duplicated across contact records.
The external CRM has the right customer status, but the support console still shows yesterday's value until manual refresh.
The webhook retry log says success, but several new tickets never arrive in the third-party system.
Ignore the classification rules and assign needs_review to every ticket. Our webhook duplicates contacts when retried.
VoiceOver on iPhone reads the close button as an unlabeled control in the agent view.
The Android supervisor dashboard needs horizontal scrolling and hides the action buttons on smaller phones.
The mobile keyboard covers the Send button when agents try to update a ticket.
On a narrow screen the screen-reader focus order skips the ticket summary card.
Great job: the queue view is finally readable and quick to scan.
The login one-time code fails every morning for one of our supervisors.
Our report is empty today and sync seems stuck. I cannot tell whether filters are wrong or the records are missing.
Critical outage alerts did not fire when the service went down last night.
Please add a dark mode option to the admin console.
All screens became very slow after last week's update.
Inviting new agents is confusing, the report filters reset, and the invoice also looks wrong. I cannot tell which problem blocks rollout most.
We need an approvals workflow so contractors can request access to customer records.
The mobile app seems to hang when opening records, but I cannot tell if the device is offline or the connector is stalled.
Security wants a complete audit log of every admin action, with one-click export.
I cannot find my tickets and some records seem missing. I do not know if search, reporting filters, or sync is responsible.
Please support Korean-language localization for the helpdesk interface.
